# Getting help

| Need | Best place |
| --- | --- |
| Install or connect a VM | [Download/setup guide](https://bloonsplus.com/download/) |
| Use the app or understand a route | [Wiki](https://bloonsplus.com/wiki/) |
| Ask the community | [Discord](https://discord.gg/qxUGXqrXsY) |
| Report a reproducible bug | [Issue forms](https://github.com/Klaasawastaken/BloonsPlus/issues/new/choose) |
| Suggest an improvement | Feature request in the issue forms |
| Report a vulnerability | [Private security reporting](SECURITY.md) |

## A useful bug report

Include the exact BloonsPlus release, Windows version, host/guest location, what you expected, what happened and reproducible steps. For replay issues, include map, variation, game version, approximate round and the failing action. Attach a short, reviewed, redacted log excerpt or support report if available.

Screenshots are optional. Crop or redact Steam names, chat messages, account identifiers and unrelated windows. Never attach saves, credentials, SSH keys or VM images. Public issue attachments are public.

Check existing issues first and add evidence to a matching report rather than opening duplicates. Route wins and setup success are not guaranteed by a preview. Volunteers respond as availability permits.

## Outside project support

Steam account access, purchases and Steam Guard remain with Steam support. Game account restrictions, game bugs and licensing questions about BTD6 remain with Ninja Kiwi. BloonsPlus is an independent project and cannot provide those services.
